{{Quote|Th&ndash;that's impossible. There are no life forms on this planet.|An Imperial crewmember aboard a bathysphere|<ref name="RPG" />}}
A '''flying life form''' lived in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of a [[Unidentified Jovian planet|Jovian gas giant]].

==Biology and appearance==
A flying life form lived in the upper [[Cloud/Legends|clouds]] of a [[Unidentified Jovian planet|Jovian]] [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]]. It stood out from the [[Color/Legends|red]] clouds of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] due to its gray coloration. Along the creature's long underside were feathery appendages and sphincters which opened and closed repeatedly.<ref name="RPG" />

==History==
At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]] encountered a member of this [[Species/Legends|species]] in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of the Jovian planet. He was aboard a [[Unidentified bathysphere|bathysphere]] with an [[Unidentified Imperial (bathysphere)|Imperial]], when he spotted one of this species ahead of the vehicle. Garnet immediately took control of the [[Bathysphere|vehicle]] and dove under the lifeform, missing it by just a few [[Centimeter/Legends|centimeters]]. Its appearance surprised the Imperial, as the gas giant was thought to be devoid of life.<ref name="RPG" />

==Behind the scenes==
This species only appeared in an example scenario in the [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|first edition rulebook]] of [[West End Games]]'s [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game|roleplaying game]], published in [[1987]].
